title: Existence and non-existence in common hypercyclicity and its frequent variants
summary: Given a family $\mathcal T = (T_λ)_{λ\inΛ}$ of bounded linear operators acting on the same $F$-space $X$ and indexed by a set of parameters $Λ\subset \mathbb{R}^d$, $d\geq1$, we explore the existence and non-existence of vectors that simultaneously satisfy, for all elements of $\mathcal T$, one of the following three dynamical properties: hypercyclicity, upper frequent hypercyclicity, and frequent hypercyclicity. Our approach relies on associating to $\mathcal T$ a "Lipschitz constant function'' $F$, whose growth encodes the interaction between the operators and the parameter set $Λ$. We…
